typography.headings: Use 'Outfit' or 'Oswald' (Google Fonts) for a cinematic, premium impact. Never use Inter/Roboto for headings. Apply tracking-tight for text-3xl and above.
typography.body: Use 'DM Sans' or 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for ultra-clean legibility. Keep line-height relaxed.
typography.rules: Avoid center-aligning the entire app. Use font-light for elegance or font-black for impact to create tension. Never default to generic medium weights everywhere.

colors.base: hsl(230, 25%, 5%) - A deep, velvety obsidian blue-black, avoiding plain #000.
colors.card: hsl(230, 25%, 9%) - Slightly lighter to create depth without relying on borders.
colors.primary_accent: hsl(189, 94%, 43%) - Cyan. Use strictly for interactive highlights, text-glows, or small dots, never as large background areas.
colors.hover_state: Color must be a lighter hue of the active state. Do not rely solely on opacity changes.

visual enhancers.glassmorphism: For floating UI and Overlays: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and a delicate 1px border-white/10.
visual enhancers.scrims: Use bg-gradient-to-t from-background via-background/80 to-transparent for text over images. NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds where text needs to be readable.
visual enhancers.glows: Instead of heavy drop shadows, use drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(6,182,212,0.4)] on active Cyan elements for a futuristic cinematic feel.

grids.NewsGrid: MODE A: TETRIS GRID. Asymmetrical and visually tense. First featured item spans full width on mobile, and col-span-8 row-span-2 on large screens. Secondary items span 4 columns. Gaps must be gap-6 or gap-8.

layouts.NewsHighlightCarousel: Max height 80vh on mobile. Ensure images fill container and apply a slow zoom effect. Overlay text strictly at the bottom over a rich dark gradient scrim.
layouts.CurrentlyStreaming: Horizontal scroller or dense bento row. Provider buttons (Netflix, Sky, etc.) should use the 'Crystal/Glass' variant: translucent backgrounds with crisp inner white borders.
layouts.FloatingNewsfilter: Fixed position bottom-right (bottom-8 right-8). Must use heavy backdrop-blur-2xl, a dark translucent background, and pop with the Cyan accent on hover.

motion.rules: Do NOT use 'transition-all'. Specifically target transition-transform, transition-colors. Use duration-500 or duration-700 ease-out for cinematic image scaling (e.g., group-hover:scale-105). Add staggered entrance animations for lists.
motion.hover_states: All cards need a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and image zoom.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure min 4.5:1 ratio for text over images by tuning the gradient overlay. Never use transparent without scrim under text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='carousel-next-button', data-testid='news-card-link').

media.images: High-contrast cinematic photography. Avoid overly bright or generic stock photos. Preserve deep blacks in images to blend with the background.

3d libraries: Not strictly required for this media portal as it relies on strong 2D imagery, but Framer Motion can be used for smooth page transitions and parallax scrolling on the carousel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Focus heavily on styling the Next.js/Tailwind codebase strictly using the provided dark theme CSS variables. Update the globals.css to include these dark mode specific HSL variables under the '.dark' class. Refactor components (in .js format) to use generous padding, grid layouts, and proper gradient overlays for text. Preserve any light mode functionality but ensure the dark mode override looks premium and cohesive. Ensure the floating Newsfilter is correctly positioned and styled with glassmorphism.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: 1. Do not use generic, symmetrical outputs. Create depth via z-index and glassmorphism. 2. Never center align the app container. 3. Disable 'transition: all' and use specific transitions (e.g., transition-transform). 4. Use 2-3x more spacing (e.g., p-6, p-8) than usual. 5. Never use emoji characters as icons, use lucide-react instead. 6. Always include data-testid on interactive elements. 7. Do not use plain transparent backgrounds over content; use blur or gradients.
